project_type: Multi-system emulator. Rust core engine (crates/emulator-bridge) compiled to WASM for a web PWA and to native ARM64 for iOS via a UniFFI Swift facade. The iOS shell (native/ios/) is built only on GitHub Actions macos-latest. This task is a Swift + XcodeGen (Info.plist) change on the ps1-pcsx-rearmed branch to make CD-based PS1 games (multi-file .cue/.bin) loadable under iOS security scoping.
language: Swift (iOS shell), YAML (XcodeGen spec + CI), Rust (engine, unchanged this task).
build_system: iOS: XcodeGen (native/ios/project.yml) -> xcodebuild, orchestrated by native/ios/build-engine.sh then native/ios/package-ipa.sh; both refuse to run on non-Darwin. Rust: Cargo workspace pinned to Rust 1.92.0. This task changes NO Rust code and NO build scripts.
test_framework: cargo test (74 unit tests). For this task the meaningful in-sandbox gates are: swiftc -frontend -parse (spell-check only, cannot see UIKit/SwiftUI types), plist/YAML lint, and cargo test/check to prove the Rust side did not regress (it is untouched).
build_command: cargo check --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings (Rust type-check; the real iOS .ipa build runs only on the macOS CI runner via package-ipa.sh).
verification_instructions: In this Linux sandbox all of these must pass: (1) swiftc -frontend -parse native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift -> exit 0 (parse/spell-check ONLY; it will NOT catch UIKit/SwiftUI type errors -- read the .fileImporter signature, .folder usage, FileManager.contentsOfDirectory usage, and startAccessing/stopAccessing security-scope balance carefully by eye). (2) native/ios/project.yml remains valid YAML (python3 -c yaml.safe_load). (3) native/ios/Info.plist remains valid XML plist (python3 -c plistlib.load). (4) cargo test -> 74 passing. (5) cargo check --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings -> clean. The macOS .ipa build and on-device multi-file cue/bin boot CANNOT run here (no macOS/Xcode/iOS SDK) and are verified only by the orchestrator's CI run afterward; document that.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The .xcodeproj is generated by xcodegen from native/ios/project.yml (gitignored). UniFFI bindings generated by build-engine.sh into native/ios/build/Generated/ (gitignored). CRITICAL: XcodeGen also GENERATES the Info.plist at info.path on every `xcodegen generate`. Confirmed from XcodeGen source (Sources/XcodeGenKit/FileWriter.swift writePlists + InfoPlistGenerator.swift): the emitted plist = auto-default keys (CFBundleIdentifier, CFBundleInfoDictionaryVersion, CFBundleName, CFBundleDevelopmentRegion, CFBundleShortVersionString=1.0, CFBundleVersion=1, CFBundleExecutable, CFBundlePackageType=APPL) MERGED with the target's info.properties map. It does NOT read the existing on-disk Info.plist content; if the on-disk file differs from that computed dictionary it DELETES and REWRITES it. Therefore the ONLY reliable way to make keys appear in the built app's Info.plist is to put them in project.yml's info.properties. The committed native/ios/Info.plist is effectively a seed that xcodegen overwrites.
setup_instructions: rustup 1.92.0 with targets aarch64-apple-ios and wasm32-unknown-unknown already installed. swiftc present (Linux Swift, Foundation only, no iOS SDK). python3 present for plist/YAML lint. No xcodegen/xcodebuild/macOS in this sandbox.
environment_constraints: No macOS, no Xcode, no iOS SDK, no xcodegen binary in the sandbox. swiftc -frontend -parse is a spell-checker only (per SESSION_HANDOFF section 16): it will accept type errors in UIKit/SwiftUI code. So the .fileImporter([.folder]) call, security-scope balance, and FileManager enumeration must be reviewed by eye. The .ipa build and device boot are CI/device-only. Network is restricted; not needed for this task.
contribution_requirements: Work on branch ps1-pcsx-rearmed; commit locally only. Do NOT push, open/modify a PR, or trigger CI (the orchestrator does that). Do NOT convert to .chd; native multi-file .cue/.bin is the requirement. Do NOT modify the Rust core, build-core.sh, build-engine.sh, package-ipa.sh, or ios.yml (they should not need changes). Do NOT change the Rust launch/need_fullpath/full_path path -- it already works with an absolute file path. Keep the 74 cargo tests passing. Update SESSION_HANDOFF.md (extend section 17). Never use em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: GROUND TRUTH from native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift (read during planning): EngineHost.launch(url:) currently calls url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() on a SINGLE picked file and stores it in `activeScopedURL`, released in stopSession(). It then calls engine.launch(coreId:contentId:rom:filename:) with rom: Data() and filename: url.path (need_fullpath, absolute path). PlayerView has @State private var importing, a computed `allowedTypes` returning [UTType.item], and a .fileImporter(isPresented:$importing, allowedContentTypes: allowedTypes, allowsMultipleSelection: false) whose .success handler does host.launch(url: urls.first). `import UniformTypeIdentifiers` is already present. The HUD philosophy: errors go to `status` (never throw to a blank screen); coreLoaded is made resident once in ensureCoreLoaded(); PS1.romExtensions = [chd, pbp, cue, iso]; systemDirectory() returns applicationSupportDirectory. THE BUG: iOS grants a security scope to the single picked .cue file only; when PCSX ReARMed (C++) fopens the adjacent .bin referenced by the cue, iOS denies access -> cue/bin games fail. FIX: pick a FOLDER, hold folder-level scope (grants the whole subtree), enumerate for the launch entry, pass that entry's absolute path to engine.launch. Rust side unchanged.
relevant_files: native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift [MODIFY: PlayerView .fileImporter -> allowedContentTypes: [.folder], allowsMultipleSelection: false; EngineHost.launch to accept a folder URL, scope the folder, enumerate contents to select the entry file by extension priority (.cue, .pbp, .iso, .chd, .bin), pass entry.path to engine.launch(rom: Data(), filename:); keep activeScopedURL lifecycle (scoped URL becomes the folder); button label -> 'Open ROM Folder...'; HUD error when no entry found; optional Documents scan]

native/ios/project.yml [MODIFY: add info.properties to the Continuum target containing UIFileSharingEnabled=true and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace=true PLUS all existing custom Info.plist keys so xcodegen emits a complete plist. This is the reliable injection path per XcodeGen source.]
native/ios/Info.plist [MODIFY: add the same two keys so the committed seed file matches what xcodegen emits and stays a faithful reference; keep it valid XML plist]
